bench_latency: bench the inference latency of a single static batch for a given model and batch size
test_correctness: test the correctness of a model by comparing prefill and decode logits against expected outputs
profile_prefill_decode: profile the prefill and decode stages of model inference with torch or CUDA profiler activities
sweep_batch_configurations: sweep through multiple batch sizes, input lengths, and output lengths and store results in a jsonl file
run_with_custom_prompts: run a latency or correctness test using custom prompts loaded from a file instead of default inputs
